input.prompt: A blank page of an old 1960s American comic book, yellowed newsprint with visible paper fibres and a faint Ben-Day dot screen, a soft fold crease, slight water stain at one corner, empty, no drawings, filling the frame edge to edge. 3D-rendered with an American comic book finish: physically modelled material, soft key light from the top left and a warm rim light, then bold black ink contour lines and Ben-Day halftone dots only inside the shadows. Saturated brand colours: cream, comic green #03c870, red #ff3a31, gold #fdbc2a. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no symbols.
